events.label: Drug C started (sulfonamide antimicrobial) for UTI
events.evidence_text: She took the first dose on the morning of 2 March

events.label: Pruritic maculopapular rash on trunk and upper arms
events.relative_text: three days after the first dose
events.evidence_text: On 5 March she developed a pruritic maculopapular rash over her trunk and upper arms

events.label: Drug C stopped
events.evidence_text: Drug C was stopped on 5 March

events.label: Rash fully resolved (positive dechallenge)
events.evidence_text: The rash faded over four days and had fully resolved by 9 March

events.label: Inadvertent re-exposure: single dose of the same agent
events.evidence_text: The patient took a single dose on 21 April

events.label: Rash recurred within 12 hours, same distribution (positive rechallenge)
events.evidence_text: the maculopapular rash recurred within twelve hours, again affecting the trunk and upper arms

events.label: Drug stopped immediately; rash resolved within three days
events.evidence_text: The drug was stopped immediately and the rash resolved within three days
